title: Aventureiros e Itens

sourceReview.fidelityNote: Full official source raster, current English Viewer, and English one-page PDF were visually compared. All four tag.important.icon occurrences and their blank callout panels are mapped; source artwork and all DOM blocks remain present.

preservedHumanRecords.text: Em Middara, os Aventureiros ganham Ouro e XP de várias formas, como ao derrotar oponentes, coletar Saque e concluir Encontros. O Ouro e o XP ganhos durante a partida são mantidos de uma sessão para outra. Os jogadores registram esses valores na Ficha de Aventura incluída no jogo.

Meaning, they may not have more than 1 Relic of the same name equipped or in their Pack at the same time. However, Adventurers may store as many Relics as they'd like in their Party Stash.

candidates.sourceText: The Party Stash
candidates.proposalText: Estoque do Grupo
candidates.proposalMarkup: Estoque do Grupo

candidates.sourceText: The Party Stash represents all the Items that the party owns but doesn't currently want to equip. The Party Stash never runs out of room and players may keep as many Items in the Party Stash as they would like. Players may put items into the Party Stash at any time, however, they may only take Items out of the Party Stash during Story Rounds.
candidates.proposalText: O Estoque do Grupo reúne os Itens que o grupo possui, mas não quer equipar agora. Ele não tem limite de espaço, então os jogadores podem guardar nele quantos Itens quiserem. Podem acrescentar Itens a qualquer momento, mas só retirá-los durante as Rodadas de História.

candidates.sourceText: Buying Items and Learning Disciplines
candidates.proposalText: Comprar Itens e Aprender Disciplinas
candidates.proposalMarkup: Comprar Itens e Aprender Disciplinas

candidates.sourceText: During the game, Adventurers will be able to spend the Gold and XP they earned to buy Items and learn Disciplines. Adventurers may only buy Items and learn Disciplines when specifically instructed to. The most common way Adventurers are able to do so is when they are given the option to Shop and Train.
candidates.proposalText: Durante a partida, os Aventureiros poderão gastar o Ouro e o XP que ganharam para comprar Itens e aprender Disciplinas. Isso só pode ser feito quando receberem instruções específicas. A forma mais comum é receber a opção Comprar e Treinar.

In order to learn a Discipline of a higher Level (LVL) in a Tree, you must already have learned a Discipline of the previous LVL in the same Tree.
